title: Chakravyuham: The Trap
desc: Satya, an investigating officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges to solve the murder case of a businessman's wife.

title: Penguin
desc: Rhythm, a pregnant woman, is traumatised by nightmares about the unsolved kidnapping of her first child, Ajay. Later, she embarks on a harrowing mission to solve the mystery of his disappearance.

title: Dear Comrade
desc: Bobby, a student union leader with anger issues, falls in love with Lilly, a state-level cricketer. However, his temperament poses an obstacle in his path to be with her.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Majili
desc: Poorna, an aspiring cricketer, falls into a deep depression after being abandoned by his lover, Anshu. Despite this, he is forced to marry his neighbour Sravani, who secretly has feelings for him.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.
